name: atomic-init-check-worktree-bootstrap
title: Make story_advance INIT_CHECK atomic with worktree bootstrap, or add a recovery path
description: Bug 2 from the 2026-06-15 ClawCreek bug report (Lattice 0.3.5), verified in source. story_advance to INIT_CHECK persists phase=INIT_CHECK to disk (cli-engine.ts:4003) BEFORE the worktree bootstrap (dev_start) runs (cli-engine.ts:4010). If bootstrap fails (e.g. storyDir-outside-gitRoot), the phase has already advanced with NO rollback (cli-engine.ts:4022-4024), and core/machine.ts:503-508 has no INIT_CHECK->INIT backward transition. Result: the story is stuck — phase reports advanced / requiresWorktree=true, but no worktree exists on disk and there is no supported way to re-bootstrap or roll back. Outcome: a failed worktree bootstrap must NOT leave a partially-advanced unrecoverable story — either the transition is atomic (defer phase write until bootstrap succeeds, or roll back on failure) or a supported re-bootstrap/recovery command exists. Scope: transactional ordering + recoverability only; do not change gitRoot resolution (that is B-2856) or the .lattice track/ignore model (separate Bug 3 story).
